description_en: Modifies the priority of a single rule configuration
description_zh: 修改单条规则配置的优先级
name: UpdateConfigSequence

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListSiteFunctions](~~ListSiteFunctions~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The target priority of the configuration. The value must be greater than 0. If the value is greater than the highest priority among all rule configurations under this feature, the priority of the configuration to be modified is set to the current highest priority. For example, if the CacheRules feature has three rule configurations with priorities 1, 2, and 3, and you change the priority of the rule with priority 1 to 5, the priority of that rule is set to 3, and the rules that originally had priorities 2 and 3 are changed to 1 and 2
parameters.help_zh: 配置的目的优先级，必须大于0，当大于此功能下最大的那条规则配置的优先级时，待修改这条配置的优先级修改为此时最大的优先级。例如：功能CacheRules下现在有三条规则配置，优先级分别为1,2,3，现在将优先级为1的那条规则配置，修改为5，那么优先级为1的那条规则配置，优先级会修改为3，原本优先级为2,3的那两条规则，优先级会变成1和2
parameters.name: sequence
